introduction.body: Peak mosquito activity coincides with spring hunting seasons — from turkey to waterfowl to early bow season. Odin's Citronella Mosquito & Insect Repellent – Liquid gives hunters a practical solution for insect control without compromising scent strategies. This synthetic, oil-based liquid creates a protective perimeter barrier when applied to foliage, brush, or ground cover around stands or blinds. With potential duration up to 720 hours, it dramatically reduces reapplication compared to traditional options that last ~20 minutes. Formulated with EPA-registered biopesticide (citronellal and geraniol), it masks the CO2, lactic acid, and octenol cues mosquitoes use to locate hosts. The milder scent profile avoids the strong chemical odors DEET produces — odors deer can detect at distance. Pairs with Odin's Citronella Scent Beads for layered coverage. Legal in all 50 states.

items.q: Can deer smell DEET mosquito spray?
items.a: Yes. DEET produces a strong chemical odor detectable by deer and other game at significant distances. Citronella-based options like Odin's produce a milder, plant-derived scent far less likely to alert game.

items.q: Is citronella safe for skin contact?
items.a: Citronella oil is EPA-registered as a biopesticide with non-toxic mode of action. Products are designed for deployment around your position, not direct skin application. If hand contact occurs, it washes off easily.

items.q: Does citronella scare deer while hunting?
items.a: Odin's synthetic scent and natural delivery use naturally occurring materials. Field observations show no notable concern from deer.

It masks the CO2, lactic acid, and octenol signatures mosquitoes use to locate hosts. Biodegradable polymer technology provides continuous release — same slow-release approach used in our hunting attractants.
Mosquitoes detect CO2 from breath over 150 feet away, lactic acid and octenol from skin and sweat at medium range, and body heat at close range.

items.q: What can I use while hunting?
items.a: Place 2–3 tablespoons of Citronella Scent Beads in a mesh bag and hang from clothing for mobile hunting. Apply Citronella Liquid to nearby foliage for stationary positions.

items.q: Does it work in hunting blinds?
items.a: It performs exceptionally well in enclosed spaces where scent concentrates. Hang a mesh bag of beads and apply liquid to surrounding areas. Users report reduced insect presence days or weeks later.

items.a: Traditional products rely on rapid evaporation. Odin's biodegradable polymer encapsulates compounds for controlled diffusion — 720 hours (30 days) of continuous exposure.
